---
title: "Data Poisoning and Grooming"
description: "Data poisoning and grooming involve the intentional creation and dissemination of customized content to influence AI training datasets, embedding specific biases and narratives into machine learning outputs."
categories: ["Operational Multipliers"]
---

::: {.function-badge}
[Operational Multipliers](../function/operational-multipliers.qmd)
:::

Deliberate generation and distribution of tailored content designed to be incorporated into large-scale data repositories and training sets, thereby embedding specific narratives or biases into artificial intelligence outputs. This form of information manipulation exploits the data ingestion processes of machine learning systems to propagate targeted perspectives indirectly through automated responses.
